rejection_summary: Penalty Loop (2024) was rejected because whole-film reviews describe a time-loop premise that turns toward comedy, introspection and trauma, with no major mystery reveals and an underwhelming final twist rather than sustained explanatory payoff. Trapped Inn (2024) was rejected because reviews describe a meandering first act, weak suspense and a muddled predicament whose supernatural/psychological hints are not coherently explored, leaving more questions than satisfying answers. No public, watched or explicit user-rejection identity reached deep research.
